title: Machine for Testing a Configuration Record
statement: For finite decidable types $Q,T$ and any predicate $P$ on an optional state in $Q$ and a tag in $T$, there are a finite decidable state type $P'$, a deterministic one-work-tape machine $R$ over the record alphabet, entry and distinct yes/no states, and a constant $C$ with the following property. Given any binary input $x$, natural number $s$, configuration $c$ over $x$, tag $\tau$, and initial configuration $d$ in the entry state whose work tape encodes the joined record of $c$ and $\tau$, the machine reaches after at most $C(|\langle\operatorname{record}(c,\tau)\rangle|+1)$ steps the same configuration except that its state is yes if $P$ holds of the state of $c$ and tag $\tau$, and no otherwise. It visits neither decision state earlier, and its work-tape head remains within distance $C(|\langle\operatorname{record}(c,\tau)\rangle|+1)$ of its initial position throughout.
